maddeler.e:
اغترفوا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَفُوا (iḡtarafū) /iɣ.ta.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اُغْتُرِفُوا (uḡturifū) /uɣ.tu.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اِغْتَرِفُوا (iḡtarifū) /iɣ.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
